ios.notes:
Duotone for iPhone 5.9.0

New
- Support Duotone in Settings › About. Donations keep the server running.
- Privacy & terms in Settings › About and on the sign-in screen.

Improved
- Duotone always opens on Home.

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v5.8.8...ios-v5.9.0

windows.notes:
Duotone for Windows 5.9.1

Improved
- Lighter on the server: artist and song details are kept on your computer, and Duotone sends far fewer requests while you listen. This keeps the app free for everyone.

Minimum version: 5.9.1

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/win-v5.9.0...win-v5.9.1
